narrative_purpose: The dim, immersive mood layer the chapter's text floats over: an ultra-wide vista of a towering tiered forest seen from high up, so deep and atmospheric that no single subject competes with the prose — a sense of a vast cathedral-forest receding into mist.
subject: An ultra-wide panorama looking across and slightly down over an immense Pandoran forest from high in the canopy: layer upon layer of giant tree crowns recede into deep atmospheric haze, a few colossal emergent trunks rising faintly through the mist, the whole scene dim and low-contrast with no bright focal subject, everything dissolving into distance.
scene: A vast canopy-top vista at great height, endless tiered forest fading into murk in every direction.
camera: An ultra-wide panoramic high vantage, everything distant, deep, and atmospheric.
light: Very low-key dawn or overcast light: faint cool glow on the nearest crowns, deep shadow and haze everywhere else; deliberately dark and low-contrast so overlaid text stays legible.
palette: Dominant void-indigo and deep teal-indigo haze, only the faintest threads of Pandora cyan on the nearest foliage, almost no bright accent.
style: Painterly speculative-biology naturalist plate, atmospheric, soft, detail dissolving into haze.
detail_level: Low overall — no crisp focal subject; everything soft, distant, and dim, dissolving into atmospheric depth.
composition: Wide horizontal mood field with deep haze, no bright focal point, generous dark expanses across the whole frame for text overlay.
consistency_notes: Macro establishing mood for this chapter; dark, low-contrast, immersive; same cool Pandora palette as the cover but far dimmer and wider.
negative_prompt: no text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no diagram labels, no arrows, no photographic or 3D-render look, no lens flares, no neon UI glow, no cartoon or anime style, no bright central subject
